scriptLines: Pacientes derive(gender = iif(lower(trim(gender)) == 'm' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'male', 'Masculino', iif(lower(trim(gender)) == 'f' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'female', 'Femenino', toString(null())))) ~> Genero

FechaNacimiento derive(insurance_provider = case(isNull(insurance_provider) || trim(insurance_provider) == '', toString(null()), startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'aetn'), 'Aetna', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'cigna'), 'Cigna', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'blue'), 'BlueCross', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'medicaid'), 'Medicaid', startsWith(replace(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), '-', ''), 'medicare'), 'Medicare', startsWith(replace(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), ' ', ''), 'united') || lower(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'uhc', 'UnitedHealth', startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'self'), 'Self-Pay', trim(insurance_provider))) ~> Aseguradoras
Aseguradoras derive(email = iif(isNull(email) || trim(email) == '', toString(null()), replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(email)), ' at ', '@'), ',com', '.com'), 'gmial.com', 'gmail.com'))) ~> Email
Email derive(phone = iif(isNull(phone) || trim(phone) == '' || lower(trim(phone)) == 'unknown' || lower(trim(phone)) == 'n/a', toString(null()), regexReplace(trim(phone), '[^0-9+]', ''))) ~> Telefono
